topic: memorial event eligibility and other December episodes
description: Anadolu confirms a Dec. 15 Peshawar gathering of thousands and an accountability statement, but it is described as a memorial ceremony; whether the event meets protest-coding definition and whether the demand represents attendees need independent review. Q001–Q004 did not establish attendance at the announced Dec. 13 gathering or substantiate other sector/region December candidates. AP search results remained held and unopened.
